sources.title: Information Freshness in Cache Updating Systems
sources.snippet: We consider a cache updating system with a source, a cache and a user. There are $n$ files. The source keeps the freshest version of the files which are updated with known rates $λ_i$. The cache downloads and keeps the freshest version of the files from the source with rates $c_i$. The user gets updates from the cache with rates $u_i$.
